newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER SHOWCASE-VFB STUTTGART PEN PICTURES.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER SHOWCASE-VFB STUTTGART PEN PICTURES.

text.p: Pen pictures of the probable VfB Stuttgart team for Sunday's German first division clash against Bayern Munich:
Franz Wohlfahrt, Goalkeeper. Age 32. Austrian international who came to Stuttgart at start of the season. 1.90 metres tall and 90 kgs.
Marco Grimm. Defender. 24. Joined from Bayern Munich in 1995. Replaces man-to-man marker Thomas Schneider against Bayern who expected to miss clash because of injury.
Frank Verlaat. Defender. 28. Dutch international who used to play for Ajax Amsterdam before joining from Auxerre in 1995. One red card this season.

Thomas Berthold, Defender. 32. Member of German 1990 World Cup-winning team but international career often been hampered by lack of discipline on the field. One goal this season but also one sending-off after two bookable offences.
Matthias Hagner. Midfielder. Age 22. Has operated on both flanks but expected to be on the right against Bayern. Four goals so far this season.
Zvonimir Soldo. Midfielder. Age 29. Croatia international who usually operates in the centre of midfield with Gerhard Poschner. Two goals this season and four yellow cards.
Gerhard Poschner. Midfielder. Age 27. Former Borussia Dortmund player who returned to VfB in 1994. One goal this season but four yellow cards.
Thorsten Legat. Midfielder. Age 28. Came from Eintracht Frankfurt in 1995. Expected to operate down the left flank. Has been suffering with shoulder injury.
Krasimir Balakov. Midfielder. Age 30. Bulgarian international who came from Sporting Lisbon in 1995. Plays just behind two strikers and has scored seven goals this season.

Giovane Elber. Striker. Age 24. Brazilian international who is the star of the team. Can turn a match with a dazzling piece of skill and has 10 goals to his credit this term. Only Karlsruhe's Sean Dundee, with 11, has scored more.
Fredi Bobic. Striker. Age 25. Euro 96 forward who has matched Elber's 10 goals this season. Bobic is more of a poacher. Haspicked up four yellow cards.
